mission: Turn the whole repository into measured, executable product capability: inventory every file, sandbox code and tools, convert useful non-code/reference assets into structured requirements/fixtures/code where appropriate, verify resource bindings, and maintain an evidence-based completion meter and ETA.

meter_dimensions.done_when: every tracked repository file has kind, owner, dependency/consumer and intended disposition
all declared bot capability contracts pass repository-controlled sandbox E2E
every claimed capability has executable runtime/tool/model binding or is explicitly non-runtime
every discoverable tool/function has normal, failure, permission, timeout and composition fixtures

the owner-designated 500-resource catalog is located, normalized, each entry classified declared/configured/authenticated/tested/certified/blocked, and no connection is claimed without executable evidence
every useful reference/document/attached asset is classified keep-as-reference, convert-to-schema, convert-to-fixture, convert-to-code, archive, or delete-by-owner; generated code is tested
required domain/role/quality/security/efficiency benchmarks are measured and mastered for release scope
every division has calibrated forecasting benchmarks and rolling scored forecasts
film/TV/music/advertising role and quality suites meet professional delivery floors
required security/privacy/rights suites have no unresolved release-blocking failures
release path, telemetry, rollback, health and cost controls are certified

time_estimation.rule: ETA is calculated from remaining benchmark/file/tool/resource work after measured throughput exists; calendar ETA must include available parallel lanes, dependencies, rate limits, approvals and paid-provider constraints.
time_estimation.confidence_rule: Do not publish a precise full-build date until at least two measured work batches establish throughput. Show low/base/high ETA ranges instead.

parallelism.goal: maximum safe parallelism, not literally instantaneous execution
serialize: writes to the same canonical file
parallelism.reason: Physical compute, API limits, dependencies and shared writers make truly instantaneous full-repository benchmarking impossible; bounded parallelism prevents races and false evidence.

continuous_bootcamp.never_stop_means: scheduled/event-driven discovery, sandboxing and regression learning continue indefinitely while respecting budgets, rate limits, permissions and safety boundaries
continuous_bootcamp.mastery_decay: mastered evidence expires or reopens when code/model/tool/provider/data changes or freshness SLA is exceeded

truth_boundary: The 8,408 passing contracts are a strong repository-controlled bot baseline, not proof that every repository file, tool, external resource, provider, professional workflow or live integration is complete. The meter must score those layers separately.
